overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Before the new council was sworn in, fewer than a quorum of members were serving, so the alleged contacts could not be a deliberation among a quorum of a public body.

allegations.summary: Alleged that a council member and a councilor-elect lobbied a quorum outside a meeting for the council vice-chair vote.
allegations.key_passage: Between November 8, 2011 and January 3, 2012, there were only three members of the Council serving who could count toward a quorum of the 2012 Council (which was five).
